phoneProvinceFit.problem: phone layout: the map tools (top right) and the colour key button (bottom right) covered constituencies in a corner of the constituency map, e.g. Nakhon Ratchasima 6 under Reset

phoneProvinceFit.method: every province opened at 390x844 and 844x390; each button's box sampled every 4 px with isPointInFill on every constituency outline; old e69-app.js served from backups/phone-province-fit-2026-11-13/

before.portrait: 73 of 77 provinces had a constituency under a button

after.portrait: 0 of 77; 39 provinces moved, median size kept 88%, smallest 68% (Pattani)

phoneProvinceFit.speed: opening 10 provinces with the CPU slowed 6x: old 470-794 ms, new 457-718 ms per render (no measurable difference)

phoneLensButton.request: the lens works only after pressing the "แตะค้าง..." button; without it the map is a plain map
phoneLensButton.change: #lensBtn (aria-pressed toggle with a switch) replaces the hint in the sea beside the south; lensReady() requires lensMode; off on every visit; placeLensBtn moves it to the nearest open sea, dropping its second line if nothing is free
phoneLensButton.result: button covers no province at any size in Thai or English; off: a finger held 450 ms or slid opens no lens and moves no tile; on: the lens opens; pressed again: off; no console errors
phoneLensButton.foundPreExisting: at 320x568 the reset/zoom row covers a corner of the north (map fills the strip's height); not changed in this round
